'''Serdor Marrak''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Marrak was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of [[Javul Charn]]'s private [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]], the ''[[Nova's Heart]]''.
